teams.synopsis: F’ it, his time is now.
teams.blurb: F’ it, his time is now. After a 155-point performance in Week 9, Aidan rises a few spots to the top of the rankings. The team goes up against a weaker opponent in Week 10, Carmine, so this spot at the top of the rankings most likely will stand in a week. In the depth metric I created on the Lineup Efficiency page, Aidan ranks first out of every single team since 2020, and on that page you can see that depth correlates with win percentage by about 30%, so it’s not a reliable predictor but it’s more likely than not that Aidan is better than his record suggests. Could this be Quigley’s year.

teams.synopsis: Despite dropping 122 points and getting the dominant win, I have dropped Baylen from the top spot.
teams.blurb: Despite dropping 122 points and getting the dominant win, I have dropped Baylen from the top spot. Don’t get me wrong, this team is great and I wouldn’t be surprised if they win it all. STATION GRITS is averaging 128 points per game, which ranks 6th all-time, however, out of the five teams that have averaged more than 128 points per game only one of them has made it to and won the championship. Still, I think Baylen is in fine positioning to win his second Preach Fantasy championship. Losing Michael Wilson hurts, but the team is deep enough to be alright.

teams.synopsis: No movement for Ben this week despite a 131-point performance and a win in Week 9.
teams.blurb: No movement for Ben this week despite a 131-point performance and a win in Week 9. I just think the team is a little too top heavy for my liking. The team’s long-term success relies heavily on Kenneth Walker III and CeeDee Lamb, which isn’t an issue, but it gives this team a dangerous floor compared to the two ranked above them this week. Week 10 is projected to be a tight matchup, but if Ben wins then he’ll most likely secure his spot in the 2026 Preach Fantasy Playoffs.

teams.synopsis: Is 4th still too low for the team with the best record in the league coming off a 125-point performance?
teams.blurb: Is 4th still too low for the team with the best record in the league coming off a 125-point performance? I don’t think so. I think this is exactly where Max should be placed at this point in time. The team is starting to get hot and put up some solid performances, but there are still a few others that have performed better and are primed to make the 2026 Playoffs. Week 10 is shaping up to be a tight contest against an opponent that Max has not played very often in the past 6 years, they’ve actually only squared off 4 times since 2020. Anyway, Max has won 6 straight matchups, which now ties ‘20 and ‘24 Ethan, ‘22 Andrew, and ‘23 Carmine as the other four teams to win 6 in a row. The only teams to win 7 in a row are ‘24 Cole and ‘25 Ryan, and the only teams to win 8 in a row are ‘21 Brandon, ‘21 Anthony, ‘23 Ethan, and ‘24 Baylen, no team has ever won 9 straight. Pretty good company to find himself in if I do say so myself.

teams.synopsis: Well Ryan didn’t need to work hard for that Week 9 win haha.
teams.blurb: Well Ryan didn’t need to work hard for that Week 9 win haha. In fact, Ryan could have sat everyone except for Joe Burrow, Christian McCaffrey, and Texans Defense and he still would have won. Now, neither the win nor the 109.8-point performance has led Ryan to move up SIX spots in this week’s rankings, but rather the culmination of recent performances and the consistency of putting up between 106 and 129 points for over a month now, while other teams have yet to show that consistency over a prolonged period of time. But yeah getting the win and putting himself in striking distance of making the playoffs for the 5th straight season also does help. Ryan opens as a huge favorite in Week 10’s Matchup of the Week, but let’s see if they can continue to execute.

They understand it now. Deniz has led his team to 3 straight wins, which is the first time the franchise has done so since 2021. I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I think it may just stop at three as Deniz is projected to lose in Week 10 by about 14 points, not a great opening spread. The rest of season schedule for Deniz also doesn’t appear to be great, as they have the hardest projected strength of schedule from Week 10 to Week 14. They match up against the 5th, 12th, 2nd, 9th, and 4th ranked teams to finish the season. Good Luck.

teams.synopsis: Oh man, what a fall from grace.
teams.blurb: Oh man, what a fall from grace. The first time Charlie has been ranked outside the top 5 all season, but I think now’s the perfect time to hit rock bottom. The team put up 81.5 points in Week 9, which is their season low, but I have a feeling it’s only up from here. Week 10 is projected to be a tough matchup against a Rolls With Butter squad that has disappointed as of recent and is hungry for a big win.

teams.synopsis: After Week 9, Quin’s trade for Bijan Robinson, Drake Maye, and Harold Fannin Jr. now ranks as the best of the season.
teams.blurb: After Week 9, Quin’s trade for Bijan Robinson, Drake Maye, and Harold Fannin Jr. now ranks as the best of the season. The team didn’t need to work too hard to earn the win in Week 9 but in Week 10 that may be a different story as they face a Max team that hasn’t lost since September. Be on the look out for Quinshon Judkins and Devonta Smith to be on the move in the coming days/weeks, Quin’s been focused on moving those two for a while now.

Where to rank N.Y. Routensss? That’s the question. Andrew had a fine performance in Week 9, and even though it ended in a loss, I still think it warrants moving up a spot in this week’s rankings. With Kirk Cousins reuniting with the Vikings, keep an eye on Andrew’s first round pick in Justin Jefferson to help the team make a playoff push. Andrew is projected to have a tight matchup in Week 10 against a tough Ben led team, but if the team can just hold off until Davante Adams comes back then they’ll be in good positioning to make the 2026 Preach Fantasy Playoffs.

teams.synopsis: Week 9 handed Anthony his 3rd straight loss and now he has a tough matchup again in Week 10.
teams.blurb: Week 9 handed Anthony his 3rd straight loss and now he has a tough matchup again in Week 10. Due to a recent trade that saw Anthony trade for Jonathan Taylor people have started to fear Rolls With Butter yet again, but I’m going to have to see it first. Anthony won his 2025 Preach Fantasy Championship with a cake walk playoff run, but I don’t think he’ll get that lucky in back-to-back years so the team will need to be better going forward. Nevertheless, Rolls always finds a way to get it done and I’ll never count him out, but for now 10th seems like a reasonable placement.

teams.synopsis: Yeah, so Week 9 saw my team drop the lowest points in a single week in franchise history.
teams.blurb: Yeah, so Week 9 saw my team drop the lowest points in a single week in franchise history. I am clearly not happy and morale has never been lower, but if the team can earn back a win this week against a soft Brandon team then I think we’ll be just fine. If we lose however, then yeah maybe the season is a wash.

teams.synopsis: Woof, rounding out the bottom three teams in the league is The Minutemen.
teams.blurb: Woof, rounding out the bottom three teams in the league is The Minutemen. Brandon has had one of his worst seasons to date, averaging just over 96 points per week, but Week 10 brings about a prime opportunity to turn things around. They match up against a team that has STRUGGLED in recent weeks and looks to continue doing the same this week. Brandon also made a big trade this week, sending the 4th overall pick, Jonathan Taylor, away for what looks to be a bunch of eh. Although, I do have my hopes for Zach Charbonnet to finish the season.

teams.synopsis: That now makes five straight losses for Carmine as we enter Week 10.
teams.blurb: That now makes five straight losses for Carmine as we enter Week 10. Like Cole, this team has failed to score points in recent weeks, Carmine has failed to eclipse 95 points for 5 straight weeks. The only bright part about his season as of right now is that he has one more win than his competition for last. Carmine now has a healthy team so no more excuses, if the team wants to make a playoff push then Week 10 is where it MUST begin.

teams.synopsis: No question the worst team in the league.
teams.blurb: No question the worst team in the league. The record shows it and the less than 100 points for 4 straight weeks shows it. With Puka now on Injury Reserve, Cole will have to get clever to avoid last place and one of the four last place punishments. The odds on favorite to finish last through 9 weeks. The schedule also doesn’t appear to lighten up either. Good Luck.

matchup_of_the_week.blurb: Some bad blood definitely brewing between these two due to recent events. All of it comes to a head with Deniz and Ryan matching up in Week 10, where Ryan is projected to have the upper hand. However, Deniz does control this matchup all-time with a 5-2 record against the commissioner. Should be fun between Dusty Deniz and Corrupt Quad.
